calculation.description: Fades the lagged three-session return, with stronger reversal exposure when current lagged volume is below its 20-session median, interpreting weak participation as lower confirmation of the move. Cross-sectional median demeaning is applied each date. All inputs are lagged through the prior completed session at decision time.

validation.regime_notes: Passes the benchmark daily paper IC and ICIR gates over 2,482 date-level cross-sectional observations. Average valid cross-section is 9 of 15 because volume history is incomplete for some synthetic instruments; uncertainty is interpreted conservatively. Positive predictive decay remains visible through 10 sessions.
